1 · Human Identity

Build the person who existed before eruption.

2 · Attributes

All begin at 1. Assign Primary / Secondary / Tertiary and spend 7 / 5 / 3 added dots. Any normal Attribute at 4 or 5 needs a descriptive quality.

3 · Abilities

Human Ability dots

Spend 23 dots. Initial purchased ratings cap at 3. Endurance 3 and Resistance 3 are free nova ratings.

4 · Backgrounds

Human Background dots

Spend 7 dots. Context notes are retained because a Background is a relationship, resource, circumstance, or position, not just a number.

5 · Bonus Points

Spent

15 points: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Specialty 1, Background 1, Willpower 2, Quantum 7, Initiative 1.

Specialties

A relevant Specialty adds +1 die. Maximum three per Ability.

Player’s Guide Module

OFF in v0.3 core. Merits, Flaws, and Player’s Guide-only traits will plug into this stage as a separate rules module instead of being mixed into core character creation.

6 · Nova Points

Spent

30 Nova Points. Tainted eligible purchases cost less but generate permanent Taint.

Normal Trait Bundles

Nova Points buy normal traits in bundles: 3 Attribute dots, 6 Ability dots, or 5 Background dots per NP. Purchase credits and allocate them separately.

Mega-Attributes

3 NP per clean dot, 2 NP per tainted dot. The normal Attribute must equal or exceed the Mega rating. Each Mega-Attribute purchased grants one associated Enhancement free.

Additional Enhancements

Quantum Powers

Core-book catalog with level, Quantum minimum, and source page. Extras increase effective power level for purchase and activation costs.

Body Modification

Fixed-cost permanent modifications are tracked separately from leveled Quantum Powers.

Taint & Aberrations

Permanent Taint above 3 requires one aberration per additional point.

8 · Growth & Training

General XP follows the published Aberrant advancement table. XP purchases require in-fiction application, research, training, or story justification. Canon restricted Instruction and Maxing XP remain track-bound. The Focused Growth campaign rule is optional and OFF by default.

Overflow ruleFocused XP converts to General XP only with this campaign rule enabled and only when that credit has no legal same-track purchase remaining. Ability tracks include eligible Specialties; Power tracks include eligible Extras.
